title: Eastern religions, meditation and the New Age
tagline: Understand Hindu and Buddhist teaching fairly, see how Christian prayer differs, and weigh yoga, mindfulness and energy healing.
whyItMatters: Many people meet yoga, mindfulness, karma and "energy" long before they meet the Gospel. The Church asks us to respect what is true in these traditions and to be clear about what is not Christian.

mindset.tip: Begin with respect: the Church rejects nothing that is true and holy in these religions (Nostra Aetate 2; CCC 843).
Ask what the practice means to your friend before you judge it. Many come looking for peace, not a new religion.
Learn the real teaching of Hinduism and Buddhism from their own texts, not from caricatures.
Keep the key difference in view: Christian prayer is a conversation with a personal God who first loves us, not a technique (CCC 2558-2565).
Be gentle with the person and clear about the ideas. A friend who tries a class is not a pagan.
